method: Source inspection of the trusted execution spine + a two-tenant real-Postgres DB simulation. Two genuine gaps were found and fixed; everything else was already correctly workspace-scoped.

surfaces.workspaceCheck: withCanonicalEnforcement requireWorkspace:true — verifiedWorkspaceId derived server-side from active workspaceMembership; fails closed 403 on no/invalid membership.
surfaces.evidenceScopeCheck: evidenceRefs ride on the workspace-scoped task; businessId now validated to belong to the workspace before any reassessment write (WRONG_WORKSPACE 403).
surfaces.auditScopeCheck: n/a at route (service writes scoped audit).
surfaces.expectedResult: owner acts; non-owner-capable actor rejected 403 at wrapper; foreign businessId rejected 403.
surfaces.testEvidence: adjudication-authorization-cross-scope.db.test.ts (service path); route capability+workspace enforced by withCanonicalEnforcement (existing wrapper tests).

surfaces.dbSimEvidence: case 3 (scoped cockpit read; B rows under same taskKeys never leak)

surfaces.actor: owner / manager / staff (role passed by the OWNER_MANAGE-gated route as server-derived 'owner')
surfaces.workspaceCheck: every processExecutionTask query filtered by workspaceId; taskKey never resolved without workspaceId; foreign task → NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN.
surfaces.evidenceScopeCheck: SUBMIT_EVIDENCE appends to the workspace-scoped task only; COMPLETE evidence-gated.
surfaces.auditScopeCheck: OWNER_PROCESS_EXECUTION_TASK_TRANSITIONED written with workspaceId in the same transaction.
surfaces.expectedResult: owner-only APPROVE/REJECT/complete blocked for non-owner (OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED); cross-workspace task not found; unsafe/monitor blocked (NEVER_AUTO); terminal blocked (INVALID_TRANSITION).

surfaces.workspaceCheck: task loaded by (workspaceId, taskKey); businessId validated in-workspace before reassessment.
surfaces.evidenceScopeCheck: EVIDENCE_REQUIRED_ROUTES + detectFakeCompletion gate; evidence appended to scoped task.
surfaces.expectedResult: completion requires evidence; owner-only completion blocked for non-owner; foreign businessId → WRONG_WORKSPACE; duplicate → INVALID_TRANSITION.

surfaces.workspaceCheck: idempotency findFirst + create + audit all scoped by workspaceId; businessId now validated in-workspace by the caller (applyProcessExecutionAction / completeProcessTask) before this is reached.
surfaces.evidenceScopeCheck: reassessment links only same-workspace source (proof/outcome) and validated businessId.
surfaces.auditScopeCheck: OWNER_REASSESSMENT_CREATED scoped by workspaceId in the same transaction.
surfaces.expectedResult: no cross-workspace reassessment linkage; a foreign businessId is rejected before any write.
surfaces.dbSimEvidence: case 5 (foreign businessId → WRONG_WORKSPACE; 0 reassessments referencing foreign business)

surfaces.workspaceCheck: proof.findMany({ where: { workspaceId, id: { in: proofIds } } }) with length check; businessId DERIVED from scoped proofs (never trusted from caller); idempotency/create/audit/read all scoped by workspaceId.
surfaces.evidenceScopeCheck: proofs must belong to the workspace or the plan is rejected.
surfaces.expectedResult: already safe — proofs and businessId are workspace-derived, not caller-trusted.
surfaces.testEvidence: existing proof-risk adjudication tests; inspected file src/services/execution/proof-risk-adjudication.service.ts:97-99,113,123,178

surfaces.workspaceCheck: verifiedWorkspaceId from workspaceMembership (userId+isActive), never from headers; unauthenticated/unauthorized/missing-workspace all fail closed with proper status codes.
surfaces.expectedResult: unauthenticated → deny; unauthorized (missing capability) → deny; no membership → 403.

gapsFound.title: Unvalidated businessId → cross-workspace reassessment linkage
gapsFound.detail: The POST route accepted businessId (UUID-only) and it flowed into createReassessmentEvent, which wrote it with NO workspace-ownership check. A crafted request could attach a reassessment (owned by the caller's workspace) referencing a businessId from another workspace.
gapsFound.fix: businessInWorkspace() guard added to applyProcessExecutionAction and completeProcessTask: a supplied businessId is validated against ownerBusiness(id,workspaceId) before any reassessment write; failure returns WRONG_WORKSPACE (403 at the route). Enforced at the SERVICE layer so every caller is protected.

gapsFound.title: actorRole read from a phantom snapshot field → owner-only actions always rejected
gapsFound.detail: The route read ctx.verifiedSessionSnapshot.role, a field that does not exist on the snapshot, so actorRole was always null. Owner-only APPROVE/COMPLETE were therefore ALWAYS rejected through the real HTTP route (fail-closed but broken — the owner could never approve). The service also trusted the passed role string rather than re-deriving it.
gapsFound.fix: actorRole is now derived server-authoritatively from the VERIFIED capability set: ctx.verifiedCapabilities.has(OWNER_MANAGE) ? 'owner' : null. Because the route is OWNER_MANAGE-gated, a reaching actor is the owner, so owner-only transitions are now authorized by proven capability, and the phantom-field trust is removed.

r4Rationale: The two-tenant DB sim proves route-level + service-level authorization, owner-only enforcement, manager/staff delegated boundaries, cross-workspace read/write/action fail-closed, evidence + reassessment + audit scoping, cockpit query scoping, and clean-workspace no-fabrication. The two genuine gaps (businessId linkage, actorRole derivation) are fixed. Adjudication/execution authorization scope is now proven, so R4 no longer applies. R6 (exhaustive whole-corpus read/audit) remains RETAINED_SAFELY as a non-blocking proof-scope restriction beyond this spine.
